dimensions.assessment: Applies to federal agencies, military personnel, law enforcement officers, and election officials involved in federal or special elections.
dimensions.evidence: troops or armed persons, including Federal law enforcement officers, are intended to be sent to any place where a general or special election is held

dimensions.assessment: Places significant procedural roadblocks and a funding prohibition on military or executive agency access to certain election records.
dimensions.evidence: No funds may be appropriated or otherwise made available to the armed forces... for the purpose of authorizing or ordering any troops or armed persons... to access any record or paper
